message.content:
Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates lucent streaks of air outlining the mediastinal structures and extending into the soft tissues of the neck (subcutaneous emphysema), which, combined with the clinical presentation of chest pain and neck crepitus in a young male, is diagnostic of primary spontaneous pneumomediastinum. There is no visible visceral pleural line to suggest pneumothorax, nor free air under the diaphragm for pneumoperitoneum.
